text: hey I appreciate the comment but I do have three things to say by way of response the first is that I don't teach the Bible I teach about the Bible from a
critical academic point of view second thing is I will wear whatever makes me happy and my graphic teas make me happy
third thing is you are misunderstanding 1 Thessalonians 5:22 and probably because of a poor translation most
people are familiar with the King James versions rendering of this which is some something like uh avoid every appearance of evil which they understand to mean
avoid anything that might appear to someone to be evil even if it's not and that is a misunderstanding the word here
that is often rendered appearance is eos in Greek and this means kind type or variety so the text is actually saying
avoid every kind type or variety of evil and there is absolutely nothing at all
evil about me wearing a Venom t-shirt or a spawn t-shirt or any other comic book t-shirt so I will continue to wear my
graphic te's and I will continue to try to help yall better understand your Bible
